_meta.note: Deliberately NOT covered by its own schema file - see contracts/README.md's Razorpay section on the payment.failed/invoice.paid gap. mapEventType's switch has no case for 'payment.failed' today, so parseWebhookEvent maps this to BillingEventType.UNKNOWN rather than throwing. This fixture exists to assert exactly that: the parser degrades gracefully on a recognized-envelope/unrecognized-event-name payload instead of failing. It DOES still validate against _envelope.schema.json (the envelope shape itself is generic), just not against any subscription.* schema (event value wouldn't match any of those consts).

entity.error_description: Payment failed due to insufficient funds in the customer's account.
